messages.content: Hi, Northline Care weekly check-in here. Hope you're doing okay this week. Do you have a blood pressure reading for me, and anything new to report?

Yeah it was 151 over 94 this morning. Also I'm basically out of my lisinopril and the pharmacy told me they need a brand new script before they can fill it. Place is 40 miles away so not exactly a quick trip.

Got it — I've logged that reading and noted you're out of lisinopril pending a new prescription. Both of those need a nurse's attention, so I'm escalating to the care team right now. Heads up: median response time is currently 31 hours. They'll reach out about next steps on the script. Anything else going on?
Is there any way you can help me sort out a ride out there? Don't have anyone to drive me and my truck's been unreliable.

I wish I could help with that — transportation isn't something I'm able to arrange right now. That's a real limitation on my end and I'm sorry about it. The nurse may have some guidance when they follow up, but I can't promise anything there. The medication issue is already in front of them.

Your next scheduled check-in is one week from today, same as usual. If your blood pressure spikes or you start feeling off before then, don't wait — reply here and we'll get someone looking at it. Take care of yourself.

theme: prescription refill needs a new script, pharmacy is far away
